title: Team | Elsa Salvati and Monica Federico, psychologists – Blooming
description: Meet the two psychologists at Blooming: Elsa Salvati for career coaching & guidance and workplace coaching, Monica Federico for psychological support and psychotherapy. Online, for people living in Italy or moving here.

data.title: Elsa Salvati and Monica Federico, two psychologists who work together.

p.t: Blooming is a small psychology and coaching practice. Elsa and Monica work online, by video call, with people living in Italy or about to move here. A job search that drags on can start to affect your sleep, and a hard time at home can make work feel impossible. That's why one practice offers both career help and psychological help. The name comes from the same idea: to bloom is to come through a difficult time, find your own resources and reach a point where you feel well again.

data.title: Elsa Salvati, psychologist and HR professional.

p.t: Psychologist, registered with the Order of Psychologists of Emilia-Romagna (no. 10626, section A) since 2022; on the register since 2014. Her entry in the register states that she offers sessions in English.

p.t: MSc in cognitive neuroscience. Postgraduate diploma in People Development and Management. Over ten years in HR, across recruitment, development, training, organisation and change management, with international academic and professional experience.

items.note: Accreditation wording of the diploma to check against the certificate.

p.t: Choosing a direction, your CV, where to look, interviews, building contacts, what to do with experience gained elsewhere, and going through a job offer before you negotiate. Elsa knows the Italian job market, so she can give you a realistic idea of what's open to you and how much Italian the roles you want are likely to need.
For when you have a job but work isn't going well: stress, a conflict that has dragged on, a change you didn't choose, or leading a team for the first time.
Hiring for key roles, team coaching and tailored training.

items.term: When someone else is the right person.

p.t: Elsa isn't a psychotherapist. If what you need turns out to be therapy, she'll tell you, and can suggest Monica. Coaching can't guarantee a job, and Elsa doesn't put clients forward to employers. Visas, the recognition of foreign qualifications and legal questions about a contract need the relevant office or professional; going through a job offer with Elsa isn't legal advice.

p.t: Psychologist, registered with the Italian Order of Psychologists since 2010. Cognitive behavioural psychotherapist. MSc in work and organisational psychology. Clinical experience in hospitals, clinics and private practice.

items.note: Registration number: to verify on the register; link to add. Year of specialisation: to confirm.

p.t: For a hard time that began at a particular point, and that you'd like to get through: a bereavement, a separation, a job that ends, trying for a baby, becoming a parent, a family member who is seriously ill, physically or mentally, or a move that turns out heavier than expected.
For difficulties that run deep or have lasted a long time. Monica works with a bio-psycho-social approach: she looks at your body, your mind and your circumstances together.
She also has an MSc in work and organisational psychology.

data.title: Elsa and Monica can work alongside each other when work and life get tangled up.

p.t: Say a parent back home becomes seriously ill, and you start seeing Monica to get through the months of calls and flights. Once things are steadier, the job you put on hold comes back into view, and Monica can suggest a few sessions with Elsa to plan your next step. You decide whether to go ahead. With your consent, Elsa and Monica can talk to each other.
